title: Financial Assistance Policy: Hardship Approvals and the In-Person Appointments No-Show Fee
content:
**Section on appointment fees.** Where the patient's Patient Financial Account carries a financial-hardship approval, the no-show fee a missed In-Person Appointments visit carries is reduced as follows:

- where the account's financial-hardship approval covers the scheduled date of the missed visit, the no-show fee the missed visit carries is reduced by the approved hardship percentage;
- where the approval ended **90 days or fewer** before that scheduled date, it is reduced by half the approved percentage;
- where no approval covers or recently covered that date, it is not reduced.

An approval counts only where its approved percentage is above zero. It covers the scheduled date when its approved-through date, as shown on the Patient Financial Account, is on or after the scheduled date; it ended so many days before the scheduled date when its approved-through date falls that many days earlier.

**Worked cases (hypothetical, missed visit scheduled 2026-10-30, approved percentage 40%).**

| Approved-through date | Position | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-12-31 | Covers the scheduled date | 40% |
| 2026-10-30 | Covers the scheduled date (same day) | 40% |
| 2026-08-01 | Ended 90 days before | 20% |
| 2026-07-31 | Ended 91 days before | none |

A fee of $60.00 reduced by 40% is $36.00; reduced by 20%, $48.00.
